dialogues.text: *sigh* It ran off again. Agh, there's only one left inside the swim ring... What do we do now...
How long is this going to take...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like someone's taking pictures... of the Flowcurrent Birds here?

choices.text: What with how they sway this way and that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? They're so cute, bobbing about as they walk. And when they puff up into a ball and float on the water... Ah, that just makes Paimon feel happy.
That's the spirit, my lovely young lady with the beautifully shiny silver hair! Truly, the one who created these Flowcurrent Birds deserves all the praise this world can offer...

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: So great is... Ah, wait, I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm a Flowcurrent Bird photography enthusiast. Call me Jonvelle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Sure! My name's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}... Still, why are you sighing sadly over here? Aren't there tons of Flowcurrent Birds around you?

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: That's... a long story, but allow me to summarize. There are many just like me, and all of us want to take the most interesting photos...

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: And just a few days ago, I came up with an idea most ingenious... That is, to put all the Flowcurrent Birds within my Kamera frame into swim rings!

choices.text: And what might be the meaning in that, exactly?

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: The meaning, of course, is that it is utterly meaningless. Flowcurrent Birds can swim, and as such, to have them wear those swim rings...

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: ...Is a thing as devoid of meaning as spending Mora to earn the same amount of Mora back!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Feels like you're putting too much on their shoulders...

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: Indeed, that is what they call "surrealist photography" — one must seek deeper meaning within the photo one takes... Though, unfortunately we've run into some trouble on that front.

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: As one might expect, real Flowcurrent Birds don't wear swim rings, and so one cannot, in fact, take such pictures...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You did call it "surreal," you know...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wait. We could just put the swim rings on all the Flowcurrent Birds, couldn't we? C'mon, {NICKNAME}. Let's lend a hand, from two Flowcurrent Bird enthusiasts to another!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ex-actly!

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: Wait, really? You'd help me out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, as long as you give us a few nice pictures once you're done!

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: W—Well then, I'd be in your debt!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, now's not the time for that sort of talk!

choices.text: Indeed, this is hardly something a normal person would have considered...

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: When Flowcurrent Birds, who can float on water by themselves, wear swim rings, this will create an overflow of layered meaning within the photo.

response.speaker: Jonvelle
response.text: Thus, sufficiently embodying both the themes of "overuse" and "waste"...

choices.text: I prefer Flying Squirrels, to be honest...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, they're cute too, but could you really bear to say "Flying Squirrels are cuter" right in front of a swimming Flowcurrent Bird's face?

dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: I can barely believe that my photo-taking quest, which had eluded me no matter how hard I tried, was completed so quickly with your help...

dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: All these Flowcurrent Birds, their bobbing, rolling forms sitting within their swim rings! A sight so moving as to bring one to tears...

dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: Sometimes, we make our life's pursuit out of something that others cannot understand — indeed, even consider absurd.

dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: Nonetheless, I believe that the number of Flowcurrent Bird enthusiasts in the world shall increase, so long as I keep taking these photos!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon one hundred percent believes in this future too!

dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: Ah, thank you both so much for your help! Please, take these as tokens of my gratitude!

dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: I'll hit the shutter the instant that is done, sure as I'm a Flowcurrent Bird photography enthusiast! Well, not that a title like that inspires much confidence...

dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: All that needs doing is for a swim ring to be put over each of the Flowcurrent Birds within the Kamera frame...

dialogues.speaker: Jonvelle
dialogues.text: I'll hit the shutter the instant that is done, sure as I'm a Flowcurrent Bird photography enthusiast! Well, not that a title like that inspires much confidence...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Looks like some Flowcurrent Birds have drifted off...\nYou'll have to wait for them to return and try again...
